protocol.analysis: Calendar-causal same-provider-well persistence and exact-seasonal arithmetic only.
protocol.target: Source-reported finite accepted mbgl reading in exact origin+6 calendar month; never filled.
protocol.reference: Persistence exact target-6; seasonal naive exact target-12; same agency and provider Well ID.
protocol.unknown_identity_policy: Exclude unknown or mismatching identity metadata; no fabricated identities.
protocol.missing_policy: No reference/target imputation or nearest-month substitution.
protocol.quality_stratum: Exact resolvable named district equals fixed-polygon district at all three dates; quality-defined before errors.
protocol.metrics: MAE/RMSE/bias/error percentiles in metres; R2 only for n>=2 and nonconstant observed values.
protocol.sign: Prediction minus observation; positive bias means greater predicted depth below ground.
protocol.geography: Conditional fixed-polygon labels; substantial source coordinate/name disagreements remain.
protocol.continuity: Matching provider ID and retained metadata are not certified replacement/measuring-point continuity.
protocol.timing: Provider-reported date/month labels; actual acquisition/publication/availability unknown. No issuance or prospective evidence.
